name: agent-disclosure
description: agent-disclosure inside Claude Code: an EU AI Act Article 50 readiness check. Does a page's chat tell people they are talking to an AI, and do generated images, audio, video and text carry machine-readable marking (C2PA, IPTC, XMP)? Reports what it finds against the law's own words; not legal advice. Open source, no account.

plugins.name: agent-disclosure
plugins.description: EU AI Act Article 50 readiness check. /agent-disclosure:agent-disclosure runs `npx --allow-git=root github:agentwares/agent-disclosure` on a URL or a file and explains where a chat discloses that it is an AI, or what marking a generated file carries, quoting the article, without calling anything compliant.
